_comment: A second, deliberately narrow question set: queries built around rare
This set exists to test a specific hypothesis rather than to report a
headline number. The main question set is dominated by paraphrased,
natural-language questions -- which is vector search's home turf -- so it
cannot show whether keyword search contributes anything. These eight
queries are the case where BM25 should earn its place.
